verdict.rationale: An LLM API platform could plausibly offer MCP-client support, for example remote MCP tools in API requests, so the axis applies. However, no evidence shows DeepSeek itself accepting or connecting to MCP servers. Function calling and OpenAI/Anthropic API compatibility are developer building blocks. Use as a backend inside third-party agents like Claude Code relies on those tools' capabilities, not DeepSeek's, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
